exercises.name: Push-ups
instructions: Lower your chest towards the floor
Push up without arching your back

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support yourself on a bench with one hand
Pull the dumbbell towards your hip

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
instructions: Start with the dumbbells at shoulder height
Press up until your arms are straight

exercises.name: Biceps Curls
instructions: Keep your elbows close to your body

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand tall with the dumbbells in front of your thighs
Push your hips back and lower with a flat back
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then stand

exercises.name: Plank (30 sec)
instructions: Forearms on the floor, elbows under your shoulders
Squeeze your glutes and keep your body in one line
Hold for 30 seconds — log the 30 when done
